turns.text: Hey Lloyd, I'm stuck on this dinner reservation for Saturday. Any recommendations for Italian near the office?
Sure! Trattoria L'Angolo is highly rated and just a 5-minute walk. Would you like me to check availability?

Please do. Also, quick note on the SimpleSeg paper I showed you: it eliminates separate decoder heads by reframing segmentation as point-coordinate sequence generation within the VLM's language space.
Understood. I've noted that about SimpleSeg's architecture. For the restaurant, they have a table at 7:30 PM on Saturday. Shall I book it?
Done. Reservation confirmed for Saturday at 7:30 PM. Anything else?
No, that's all. Oh, did the package for the new monitor arrive?
Tracking shows it will arrive tomorrow morning between 10 AM and 12 PM.
Lloyd, the weather looks terrible for tomorrow. Should I cancel my jog?
The forecast predicts heavy rain from 6 AM to 10 AM. I'd recommend moving it to the afternoon or skipping it.
I'll skip it. By the way, I was reviewing SimpleSeg again. It's a semantic segmentation model that eliminates the SAM decoder by generating segmentation in language space.
Got it. That aligns with what you mentioned earlier about using language space for segmentation.
Right. Can you also set a reminder for my dentist appointment next Tuesday?
Sure. What time is the appointment?
Reminder set for next Tuesday at 2:00 PM for your dentist appointment.
